description: A nighttime residential garden pathway scene. A wide paver walkway in warm tan stone extends from the foreground into the deep dark background, flanked on both sides by low brick pillar columns built from pale buff-colored brick. The near column is sharp in focus at the center of the frame; two additional columns recede in soft bokeh down the path behind it. Dense low garden plantings — yucca-like spiky plants and spreading flowering groundcovers — border the walkway. The background is pure dark, with no sky or architecture visible, giving a deep night atmosphere. Warm amber horizontal bands of light radiate from each column-top position, casting a soft golden glow across the flat cap stones and onto the brick faces. The paver walkway below each column glows faintly with the wash of warm light. The mood is intimate, dramatic, and distinctly nighttime garden.
